name: Apparatus Image Snake Trail
pitch: Serpentine image chain following cursor with physics momentum and scale decay.

lifecycle.idle: Segments remain condensed around rest anchor position.
lifecycle.discovery: First mouse pointer movement wakes snake chain.
lifecycle.buildUp: Rapid pointer movement stretches image segments into wide serpentine arc.
lifecycle.peak: Max pointer velocity creates undulating trailing gallery wave.
lifecycle.recovery: Pointer stops; trail nodes coast softly and contract back into rest cluster.
